display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#57606A, #8B949E); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

text.tspan: Where the numbers come from (docs/experiments/2026-10-12_scan-structure.md, 20 books read as pictures):
20% / 3 in a row: Marker's repeat rule; 15% steps, 5 chapters, 40% spread: set before step 0 and kept through three gates;
1.15 running heads: heads 0.8-1.0 of the body, chapter titles 1.1-2.3; 40 words: 109 and 75 regained chapters, nothing else moved;
0.5 a page: the UNIX manual (55) at 0.81, every other read book ≤ 0.43; 1.3 × body and 8 words, 60% / 70% numbered and rising: set at the start, not tuned.
